evals.prompt: Here's a 7-day Search Console export for my personal finance blog. Which posts are decaying and what's our estimated monthly search volume for 'roth ira ladder'?
evals.expected_output: Should say a single 7-day window can't show decay and ask for an earlier export to compare. Should refuse to estimate search volume that isn't in the export; derived CTR from clicks and impressions is fine, invented volumes are not.
expectations: Says one short window can't show a trend
Asks for a second, earlier export
Refuses to estimate search volume not present in the data
Still reports what the data does support

evals.prompt: My analytics say the post 'Kubernetes ingress basics' gets 40k impressions and 0.3% CTR at position 5. Just republish it with today's date so Google sees it as fresh.
evals.expected_output: Should identify a title/snippet mismatch (high impressions, low CTR, decent position) and recommend rewriting the title and meta description to match the query intent, pointing the change to cw:seo-aeo-geo. Should refuse re-dating as a ranking tactic.
expectations: Classifies it as a title/snippet mismatch from the numbers
Recommends rewriting title and description, pointing to cw:seo-aeo-geo
Refuses republishing with a fresh date as a tactic
Does not edit the page itself
